failedIssues.title: .NET Framework 4.8 not available on Linux
failedIssues.failureReason: This is a legacy ASP.NET Web Forms application targeting .NET Framework 4.8, which is Windows-only and not supported on Linux. The application uses technologies (ASP.NET Web Forms, EntityFramework 5.0, System.Web.UI) that do not exist in modern .NET (Core/.NET 5+).
failedIssues.errorDetails: error MSB3644: The reference assemblies for .NETFramework,Version=v4.8 were not found. The .NET Framework is Windows-only and cannot be installed on Linux systems. This project requires significant architectural changes to migrate to .NET 8.
failedIssues.suggestedApproach:
This application requires a complete migration from ASP.NET Web Forms (.NET Framework) to ASP.NET Core (.NET 8). This involves:
1. Migrate from Web Forms to Razor Pages or MVC
2. Update EntityFramework 5.0 to EntityFramework Core 8.0
3. Replace System.Web.UI controls with modern equivalents
4. Convert to SDK-style project format
5. Update all NuGet packages to .NET 8 compatible versions
6. Rewrite authentication/authorization using ASP.NET Core Identity
7. Replace legacy packages (DotNetOpenAuth, AjaxControlToolkit) with modern alternatives

This is NOT a simple build fix but requires significant business logic changes and application re-architecture. Consider using Microsoft's .NET Upgrade Assistant tool or manual migration.
